description: Starts a subscription to a specific event.

parameters.name: subscription_name
parameters.description: The type of event you want to subscribe to (i.e., newHeads, logs, newPendingTransactions). This method supports the following subscription types:

sub_parameters.name: newHeads
sub_parameters.description: It fires a notification each time a new header is appended to the chain, including chain reorganizations

sub_parameters.name: logs
sub_parameters.description: It returns logs that are included in new imported blocks and match the given filter criteria

sub_parameters.name: newPendingTransactions
sub_parameters.description: It returns the hash for all transactions that are added to the pending state and are signed with a key that is available in the node

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: If true, method will return the full transaction data, otherwise only the transaction hash

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The arguments such as an address, multiple addresses, and topics. Note, only logs that are created from these addresses or match the specified topics will return logs

result.description: The hex encoded subscription ID. This ID will be attached to all received events and can also be used to cancel the subscription using eth_unsubscribe
